standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: new controllers may introduce docker_network_policy without prior staged capability evidence
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: new controllers must omit docker_network_policy until engine rollout is proven

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: malformed referenced host groups and non-string enum values can crash validation
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: type-check referenced host groups and enum values and return accumulated validation errors

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: initializer emits Docker network policy before per-controller engine evidence
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: initializer omits optional fields; explicit bridge input emits a review-only policy fragment

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: bridge capability checks depend on transition context and engine upgrades cannot promote staged next-engine records
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: always require matching bridge evidence and verify promotion from the previous integrated next-engine sidecar

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: storage retention admission is not ordered after an existing controller engine
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: require same-engine admission on active or drained predecessors and remove admission in an earlier commit before any engine_ref change

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: storage retention is permitted on disabled controllers
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: restrict storage retention declarations to active or drained controllers

standalone_safety_deltas.reviewed_core_gap: manager bootstrap does not integrate standalone pending next-engine evidence or storage transition ordering
standalone_safety_deltas.standalone_enforcement: require prior target-engine capability evidence and retain pending sidecars through both bootstrap revisions; require storage removal before changing the selected engine even during manager staging
